'''Sleightan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]]. Along with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[L7-BO]], Sleightan ran a scam where he would sell the droid to group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], claiming it was the property of his dead son, [[Armbrus]]. Once the deal had been done, L7-BO would find an opportunity to leave the spacers and rejoin Sleightan so they could run the scam again.<ref name="FC" />
